Drone rental: current screens

34 screens captured today from the latest code on a phone-sized display, using test data that has since been deleted. Tall pages are cropped here; open an image on its own to see the whole page.

Home page

The dark landing page. Book a drone goes straight to the shop picker.

Customer: booking online

Pick a shop, a length and batteries, a day and time, enter details, pay, then show the QR at the shop.

Merchant: accepting an online order by QR

The merchant scans the customer's QR, checks the name, and presses Accept order. Cancel changes nothing, so the same QR can be scanned again.

Walk-in customer: the shop's QR

The shop has one permanent walk-in QR. The customer scans it in the store and fills everything in. The merchant just confirms the order, then does the checklist and photos.

Merchant: guided photos, one per page

Handover and return each use seven photo pages (power on, front and camera, top and propellers, underside, controller, battery, everything together), then a last page for the checklist. Every photo is required, and Back keeps photos already taken.

Merchant: battery swap and return

Swapping one or two batteries mid-rental, and the return with a Fine, Damaged or Lost choice for the drone and the controller.

Admin

Grouped home page and a Drone Rental page that now shows how the business is doing.

Captured from the local copy of the app. The only difference from the live site is the orange test-only buttons, which don't appear in production.
